about.title: Our Mission
about.description: We are a political party committed to serving the people, strengthening communities, and creating meaningful opportunities for every citizen through responsible and inclusive governance.

foundationalVision.title: The Ideals of Great Leaders Are Our Foundation
foundationalVision.description: Advancing the ideals of great leaders of the Bahujan movement in Telangana and rebuilding the spirit of historic struggles for self-respect and political power form the foundational vision of the JAC.

points.title: Ideals of Great Leaders
points.description: Advancing the ideals of great leaders of the Bahujan movement, including Buddha, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, Mahatma Jyotirao Phule, Shahu Maharaj, Kanshi Ram and others, across Telangana.

points.title: Self-Respect & Political Power
points.description: Rebuilding the banner of self-respect and political power inspired by Sammakka-Saralamma, Sarvai Papanna, Pandaga Sayanna and Konda Laxman Bapuji.

points.title: Political Power for the 90%
points.description: Working towards making political power achievable for the BC, SC, ST and minority communities that constitute 90% of Telangana's population.

points.title: Resistance to Political Conspiracies
points.description: Countering what the JAC identifies as political conspiracies by upper-caste feudal capitalists and the earlier JAC of 2009.

about.driveText2: We believe lasting progress begins by listening to citizens, understanding the needs of every community, and turning those aspirations into responsible action. Our commitment is to work with integrity, accountability, and a clear focus on the public good.

highlights.title: People First
highlights.description: We put the needs, rights, and aspirations of citizens at the heart of every decision and public initiative.

highlights.title: Transparent Governance
highlights.description: We believe public institutions must be accountable, transparent, and responsive to the people they serve.

highlights.title: Inclusive Development
highlights.description: We work towards equal opportunities and sustainable development so that every community can participate in and benefit from progress.

vision.title: A Stronger Future for Everyone
vision.description: Our vision is to build a society where responsible leadership, inclusive development, and equal opportunity create a better future for every citizen.

mission.title: Serving the People, Strengthening Communities
mission.description: Our mission is to serve the people, empower communities, and create meaningful opportunities for every citizen through responsible and inclusive governance.

cta.title: Be Part of the Change
cta.description: Join us in building stronger communities and a future where every citizen has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and prosper.

timeline.eyebrow: ONE YEAR & THREE MONTHS OF STRUGGLE
timeline.title: A Journey of Struggle for the People
timeline.description: Key milestones from April 2025 to May 2026 in the movement for people's rights, land, reservations, representation, and social justice.

april2025.title: Ma Bhoomi Rathayatra Begins in Adilabad
april2025.description: On 14 April 2025, the 100,000-kilometre 'Ma Bhoomi Rathayatra' was launched in Adilabad. It marked the beginning of a long-term people's movement across Telangana for land rights, self-respect, and people's rights.

november2025.title: Dharmadeeksha & Aakrosha Sabha for 42% BC Reservations
november2025.description: A Dharmadeeksha was held at Osmania University demanding 42% reservations for BC communities. This was followed by an Aakrosha Sabha in Kamareddy, strengthening the demand for social justice and equal representation.

februaryMarch2026.title: Legal Fight for Kummera Victims & Khammam Bhoodan Land Struggle
februaryMarch2026.description: The movement continued its legal fight for the affected people of Kummera while strengthening the struggle for Bhoodan lands in Khammam. The campaign remained focused on land rights and justice for affected families.

may2026.title: 'Share According to Population' Public Meetings
may2026.description: Public meetings were held around the call, 'Share according to the population of each community', highlighting the demand for proportional representation, social justice, and political empowerment.

news.title: Our Struggle for the People
news.description: The JAC continues to stand with the people in the fight for land rights, dignity of labour, employment, and justice for farming communities.

maBhoomiRathayatra.title: A 100,000-Kilometre Ma Bhoomi Rathayatra
maBhoomiRathayatra.description: Launched on 14 April 2025 from Adilabad, the Ma Bhoomi Rathayatra is a long-term people's movement across Telangana, continuing for three years and three months in the pursuit of land rights, self-respect, and political empowerment.

velugumatlabhoodanland.title: Justice for Velugumatla Bhoodan Land Families
velugumatlabhoodanland.description: The JAC stood with more than 700 homeless families seeking justice over the Bhoodan lands at Velugumatla in Khammam. The movement played a key role in securing a High Court status quo order in support of the affected families.

volunteerNetwork.title: Standing With Industrial Land Victims
volunteerNetwork.description: The JAC stood with families affected by industrial land acquisition in Kadlapur and Rapole in Parigi. Through protests, dharnas, arrests, and sustained public pressure, the movement continued the fight for justice and ultimately achieved a significant victory.

farmersfamilies.title: Standing With Nadergul & RRR Land Victims
farmersfamilies.description: The JAC brought the concerns of land-affected families in Nadergul and along the Regional Ring Road to the authorities. A representation was submitted to the Governor on behalf of the affected families as the struggle for justice continues.

workersUnemployed.title: For the Dignity of Labour and Workers' Rights
workersUnemployed.description: The JAC has stood with hamalis in Ichoda, Civil Supplies workers, sanitation workers, and other working communities. Advancing the principle of 'Dignity of Labour', the movement has also supported RTC employees and the demand for a corporation for outsourcing workers.

developmentPriorities.title: Standing With Bereaved Farmer Families
developmentPriorities.description: The JAC visited and stood by the families of Kode Govind and Kummari Lingaiah, who died by suicide amid the lack of remunerative prices, and Ugge Hanumanth, who died from an electric shock. Supporting affected farming families in their time of grief remains a responsibility of the movement.
